body:
ops/stalwart/: terraform/ (Cloudflare A record for mail.carepyre.org, validated live against the real provider schema) + ansible/playbooks/stalwart.yml (installs via the real official installer, writes verified-schema config.json, pins recovery-admin credential, opens firewall, enables systemd). Real, live-checked finding: carepyre.org's Cloudflare zone is status=pending due to an ns_typo mismatch at the registrar -- needs fixing before DNS resolves. Real, honest gap named: Stalwart's one-time admin-UI setup wizard has no safe non-interactive path yet, named as v1 follow-up rather than guessed at.

⚓ ☃
title: Real Stalwart Terraform (DNS) + Ansible (provisioning) shipped
